description: Routing for the 4th team tool (wikipedia): background-knowledge questions go to wikipedia, news stays on lookup. Tool output is checked offline in tests/test_tool_wikipedia.py.

cases.query: Anthropic là công ty gì? Tra Wikipedia giúp mình.

cases.query: Who is Demis Hassabis? Look him up on Wikipedia.

metadata.what_it_tests: English background question about a person uses wikipedia with the page title, not timeline.

cases.query: Tin tức mới nhất về Anthropic hôm nay là gì?

metadata.what_it_tests: Negative control: a news request about the same company stays on lookup and does not drift to wikipedia.
